create_tool_registry: create a ToolRegistry instance with initial checker data and app and tool aliases
add_tool_alias: add an alias for an existing tool function name in the ToolRegistry
add_app_alias: add an alias for an existing app name across all its tool functions in the registry
check_checker_type: check if a CheckerType enum value is a hard or scripted checker using is_hard or is_scripted
lookup_soft_checker_types: lookup the soft checker types for a given tool in the TOOL_SOFT_CHECKER_TYPE_REGISTRY
